claude-haiku-5-5.note: Claude Haiku 5.5, released 7 Oct 2026. Prices apply to prompts up to 100,000 tokens (above that USD 0.50/2.50); this pipeline never sends more than 32,768 bytes. Same text is about 30% more tokens than on Haiku 4.5. Source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-5-5/overview, read 8 Oct 2026.

note: Gross token rates, before promotional credits. Flash-Lite profiles are calibration-only, never an implicit candidate fallback. Output includes reasoning. The USD50 lifetime guard includes historical settled content charges and conservative unresolved holds from the persistent ledger.
input_bound_note: max_input_tokens is enforced as a UTF-8 byte bound on the request body (about three times stricter than tokens). Raised from 24576 to 32768 on 2026-10-06 for longer exact NCERT spans; token rates unchanged. On 8 October the Luna/Gemini internal UTF-8 request bound was raised by 256 bytes to 33,024 after an offline measured 32,816-byte request; token rates and expiry unchanged. Every new reservation uses the increased conservative maximum; persisted older request contracts keep their original bounds. This is an internal byte cap, not a provider context-window claim.
cache_pricing_note: OpenAI prompt-cache reads and writes use the published distinct rates; cache input partitions must be subsets of total input. Batch rates are 50% of Standard. Verified against official model/pricing pages on 6 October 2026.
flex_note: Flex processing is billed at 50% of standard rates, the same as Batch (OpenAI GPT-6 Luna model page, read 8 Oct 2026). Applied only when the response reports service_tier flex.
